hook: 210 tokens per second, locally, on a Mac Studio.
hookText: Inkling 2 Mini runs fast on Macs

beats.say: EXO Labs worked with Thinking Machines to make Inkling 2 Mini run fast on Apple Silicon.
On a 96 gigabyte M5 Ultra Mac Studio it decodes 210 tokens per second, and on a 48 gigabyte M5 Max MacBook Pro, 125.
Prefill hits 3,620 tokens per second on the Studio, and in their demo it built a native weather app 1.8 times faster than Claude Sonnet 5.5.
